card.name: Street numbers in contact addresses
card.fires_on: Digits or spacing at the start of a street address, right before the street name, in contact blocks for organizations (mailing addresses, phone lines). Also fires on a gap right after an organization name, where an address follows.

modes.label: Street number digits
modes.description: A digit inside a street number just before the street name, such as Fishers Lane or Fernbrook Lane.

modes.label: Gap before address or next heading
modes.description: A space or line break after an organization name or title, where an address or new section begins.
